As the Head of High Voltage Power Transformer Test Field at our new Siemens Energy Transformers Repair Center in Linz, Austria, you will play a pivotal role within the organization planning, developing, and advising the testing of the power transformer. You will lead employees according to the Company's goals and current regulations and provide the necessary resources.
